metadata.title: Clicked like I was swatting a fly and somehow triple gifted the enemy?! Valorant aim broke again
metadata.description:
Me: panicking like I forgot which button fires
Enemy: probably uninstalling mid-confusion
How did that triple kill even happen? No clue but I’m cashing in
If your aim’s a lovable disaster, this one’s for you

Tap if your aim’s as gloriously broken as mine!

#valorant #luckykill #gamingfails #funnygaming #shorts
